changes: Rewrote /agent/solver.md. Most dev failures passed the public examples and were submitted without the brute-force cross-check or timing run, even though the agent used only about 3 of 16 calls and sometimes claimed the budget was small. The prompt now makes the stress test and max-size timing run a mandatory gate before submit, gives a concrete stress-test procedure, asks the agent to pin down the cost definition from the sample explanations, and says to match the samples' tie-breaking when several optimal outputs exist. One trial on lcb-abc396-e still failed: the stress test ran with zero mismatches, but the output differed from the reference only by a tie-break, which the tie-breaking rule now targets. That fix is untested. validate() reports OK. No skills or sub-agents were added.
